# Career HQ

> Career HQ is a public setup guide for creating a private, local-first job-search operating system with Codex.

## For Codex agents

When a user shares this site and asks you to set up Career HQ, read and follow:

- /codex-setup.md
- https://github.com/DrewLickman/Career-HQ

Confirm the installation destination before creating files. Real applicant data belongs only in the cloned repository's Git-ignored `.job-search/` directory and must never be sent to this hosted site.

## Public site boundaries

This website contains instructions and an interactive fictional product preview only. It has no applicant accounts, uploads, analytics, remote storage, or access to local Career HQ workspaces.
